title: Deeper/broader open-source peer failure taxonomy and validation-boundary refresh
scope: Refresh LibreDWG version/operation claims, fuzz-route documentation, and security boundaries
Cross-map current ACadSharp parser, writer, graph-cost, and native-acceptance issue reports
Separate ezdxf paperspace rendering behavior from DXF codec support
Reconcile findings against existing libdxfrw owners and keep implementation validation fast

method.kind: Read-only review of public project documentation, issue pages, security advisories, and the local plan
method.limitations: GitHub issue descriptions and mutable project documentation are reports, not independent reproductions. No peer binary/package was pinned or executed. Findings are mapped to existing local owners by source/plan review only.

sources.observed: Documents distinct DWG, ASCII DXF, binary DXF/DXB, conversion, and fuzz entry paths; the project documentation and generated CLI manual differ in their writer-version wording.
Documents separate fuzz targets and replayable crash/hang/leak cohorts.
Reports a pre-0.14 R13-R2000 class-count-driven resource-consumption defect, fixed in release 0.14. This is a peer-specific mechanism lead, not a libdxfrw reproduction.

sources.revision: public advisory index and 0.14.1 NEWS reviewed 2026-10-17
sources.observed: Separately lists a pre-R13 allocation issue and a const-input text-conversion issue; NEWS records corresponding upstream fixes. These mechanisms and version ranges must not be conflated with the in-scope AC1012+ local reader.
Closed report attributes a large group of fuzz crashes to a harness-only double-free, demonstrating that fuzz harness integrity is a prerequisite for interpreting crash counts.

Current issue horizon includes separate reports for repeated DXF reader stack growth (#1281), DWG EED writer size loss (#1282), nested-block deep-copy cost/stack growth (#1283), AC1032 whole-file native rejection (#1297), and a DWG-to-DXF spline report (#1299). These belong to distinct routes and are not local reproductions.
Open report concerns paperspace viewport linetype scaling in the drawing add-on and $PSLTSCALE. It is a rendering/layout behavior report, not a DXF parse/write claim or local execution result.

sources.revision: worktree plan over baseline de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9 reviewed 2026-10-17
sources.observed: All concrete peer reports map to existing PAR, fast-test, graph/resource, or composed acceptance owners; no unowned local source-confirmed defect was established.

assessment.peerFailureTaxonomy: Separate parser safety/progress, writer width/serialization, document graph/copy complexity, native whole-file acceptance, and downstream rendering. One route's result does not imply another route's behavior.
assessment.libreDwgApplicability: Use exact version/operation and format-family scope. R13-R2000 reports may inform bounded parser tests; pre-R13-only advisories do not widen libdxfrw's AC1012+ support target. Do not transplant peer limits or code.
assessment.acadsharpApplicability: Reuse existing local EED, repeated-record, graph-cost, MTEXT, and spline owners. Keep whole-file native rejection and underspecified spline reports at their existing composed evidence gates.
assessment.ezdxfApplicability: Keep paperspace rendering and PSLTSCALE behavior outside DXF reader/writer parity claims; if rendering is studied, pin layout settings and renderer profile explicitly.
assessment.implementationSpeed: Keep focused generated route-specific tests as the slice gate. Reserve long fuzz/sanitizer, external peer, native CAD, and full-suite work for existing composed/scheduled checkpoints.
assessment.supportEvidence: No reviewed route closes independent DWG object/owner interpretation, DXF/ACIS carrier preservation, exact solid semantics, and native Linux/Windows acceptance as one chain.
